title: Polyhedral Subspaces of $L_{p}$ and Polars of Zonotopes
summary: Let $K$ be an origin-symmetric full-dimensional convex polytope in $\mathbb R^n$, $n\ge 3$. We show that, for $-n+3<p<1$, the normed space $(\mathbb R^n,\|\cdot\|_K)$ embeds in $L_p$ if and only if it embeds in $L_1$. The case of $p\le 0$ is understood in the generalized sense. In particular, an origin-symmetric full-dimensional convex polytope $K\subset\mathbb R^n$, $n\ge 5$, is an intersection body if and only if $K$ is the polar of a zonotope.
